_doc: #1939 THE agent list of Cloud SuperIntel, declared in app data: the composer's Agent picker (libs:ai AiAgents.load reads assets/agents/agents.json, this app's copy shadows the shared descriptor of libs:model-catalogue) and Models > Agents read this ONE file, so they cannot drift (test-superintel-agents.sh holds every agent of the shared descriptor here). The descriptor fields are the shared ones (id is the gateway's X-Agent-Mode value, health_key its /health.agents key); the page fields are icon, what, where, models and `gateway` (false = not a mode of the gateway: listed on the page, not offered in the composer). Live status is layered on top from the gateway's /health and never decides what is listed, so the list is never empty while the gateway is down.

agents.label: Hermes
agents._doc: Nous Hermes Agent (native API once HERMES_API_KEY is wired, else the Hermes model behind the gateway's MCP loop); the gateway picks the model
agents.what: Nous Hermes Agent: a tool-using agent with the fleet MCP servers; native API when its key is wired on the gateway, else the Hermes model behind the gateway's MCP loop.
agents.where: Fleet gateway my-ai-api (mesh only), service cloud-agi-hermes
agents.models: Fixed: the gateway picks the Hermes model (the live name shows once the gateway answers)

agents.label: Goose
agents._doc: Block's goose, the gateway's default agent; GOOSE_MODEL
agents.what: Block's goose: the gateway's default agent, a tool-using loop over the fleet MCP servers.
agents.where: Fleet gateway my-ai-api (mesh only), service cloud-agi-goose
agents.models: Fixed: the gateway's GOOSE_MODEL (the live name shows once the gateway answers)

agents.label: Claude Code
agents._doc: the subscription claude CLI behind claude-superset-api; an Anthropic catalogue row is passed as the CLI model
agents.what: Claude Code: the subscription claude CLI behind claude-superset-api, with tools and MCP.
agents.where: Fleet gateway my-ai-api (mesh only), claude-superset-api on oci-apps (cloud-agi-claude)
agents.models: Anthropic catalogue (anthropic/...): the model picked in Models is passed to the CLI

agents.label: Google AGY
agents.backend: antigravity (Cloud Run, us-central1, behind an OAuth proxy)
agents.what: Google Antigravity (AGY): Google's agent IDE service, declared in the fleet by ticket #1432.
agents.where: Cloud Run service agy (us-central1) behind oauth2-proxy; not a mode of the fleet gateway yet
agents.models: Google's own (Antigravity); none is offered through the gateway yet
agents._doc: Declared so the Agents page lists it. It is not a gateway mode: the composer's picker does not offer it (Select is off) and its status is not deployed until #1432 lands (unmanaged service, secrets not loaded).

agents.label: OpenClaw
agents._doc: OpenClaw (MIT), cloud-agi-openclaw on oci-apps since 2026-10-13: its gateway on 127.0.0.1:18789 only, reached through the fleet gateway's openclaw mode, which forwards only the messages and the agent target (openclaw/default). It runs the model its own config names (the fleet model through the gateway's OpenRouter face), with its own tool plugins; no fleet MCP servers are configured in it, and the gateway sends no reasoning field.
agents.what: OpenClaw (MIT): its own gateway and tool plugins, reached through the fleet gateway's openclaw mode.
agents.where: Fleet gateway my-ai-api (mesh only), service cloud-agi-openclaw on oci-apps
agents.models: Fixed: the model OpenClaw's own config names (openclaw/default)

agents.label: DeepSeek Harness

model._doc: the gateway runs only a deepseek/... model in this mode (v4-pro, v4-flash, r1); any other pick falls back to its DEEPSEEK_MODEL, so the app sends the default instead

agents._doc: The DeepSeek harness: a gateway MODE (no service of its own, fleet null), DeepSeek's models on OpenRouter driven through the gateway's MCP tool loop (callOpenRouterAgentic). Text only: DeepSeek's chat models take no images. No native web search; web comes from the fleet MCP tools when present.
agents.what: The DeepSeek harness: DeepSeek's models on OpenRouter driven through the gateway's MCP tool loop (text only).
agents.where: Fleet gateway my-ai-api (mesh only): a gateway mode, no service of its own
